T: They killed his dog. Feed yours first.
D: A retired hitman comes back to settle the score with the Russian mob.
P: Serve the drinks when John sits at the bar in the Continental.
S: Lacy baked parmesan crisps with thyme

Lacy, golden parmesan crisps baked in small coin-sized rounds with cracked black pepper and a little thyme, served with a smoky tomato jam. Grate 150g parmesan finely and mix with picked thyme leaves. Spoon into small rounds on a tray lined with baking paper, leaving space between. Bake at 190C for 6 minutes until lacy and golden. Crack black pepper over each and cool on the tray to crisp. Serve with a small bowl of tomato chutney for dabbing.
Warm green olives with orange peel, rosemary and garlic, plus toasted almonds
Green olives warmed in olive oil with orange peel, rosemary and garlic, served with salted almonds.
the Russian boss getting very bad news about his son

Warm blini with sour cream and salmon roe, buttered rye topped with pickled herring and red onion, and cold dill pickles alongside. Warm 16 blini at 180C for 4 minutes and top each with a little sour cream, salmon roe and dill. Butter 4 slices dark rye, cut into fingers and top with 200g drained pickled herring and thinly sliced red onion. Halve 4 dill pickles lengthways. Lay everything out on a board and serve with ice-cold vodka for anyone who wants it.
M: Dinner for twelve braised short ribs
Beef short ribs braised 4 hours in red wine, served with the reduced sauce

Beef short ribs braised slowly in red wine, garlic and thyme until falling off the bone, glazed with the reduced sauce over creamy parmesan polenta. Season and brown 2kg beef short ribs in batches. Add 375ml red wine, 500ml stock, 4 garlic cloves and thyme. Cover and braise at 150C for 4 hours until tender. Lift out the ribs, skim the fat and reduce the sauce until glossy, then return the ribs to coat. Cook 200g polenta in 1L water, stirring, for 10 minutes, then beat in 40g butter and 40g parmesan. Spoon the ribs over.
the quiet house before the trouble

Dry-brined rib eye seared in cast iron and basted with butter, garlic and rosemary, rested and sliced, with a sharp rocket, parmesan and lemon salad. Salt 4 rib eyes and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Sear in a smoking cast iron pan for 2 minutes a side, then add 50g butter, 3 crushed garlic cloves and rosemary and baste, turning, until 54C inside. Rest 8 minutes and slice. Toss 2 bags rocket with shaved parmesan, lemon juice and olive oil.
W: Peanut butter shortbread bones, half dipped in dark chocolate
Peanut butter shortbread cut into little bone shapes, baked at 170C for 12 minutes, half dipped in dark chocolate. Human food only.
K: Bourbon, lemon and egg white shaken frothy, over a big ice cube

Bourbon shaken hard with fresh lemon, sugar syrup and egg white until silky, served over a big cube with a few drops of bitters on the foam. For each drink, shake 60ml bourbon, 25ml lemon juice, 15ml sugar syrup and 1 egg white hard without ice for 10 seconds, then add ice and shake again. Strain over a large ice cube in a heavy glass. Dot 3 drops of aromatic bitters on the foam.

veg.n: Dinner for twelve red wine braised mushrooms

ingredients.item: mixed portobello and king oyster mushrooms, in big pieces

steps.text: Season and brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Add the onion, garlic and tomato paste and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the wine, stock, lentils and thyme. Cover and simmer gently until the lentils are tender.
Uncover and reduce the sauce until glossy and coating the mushrooms.
Cook the polenta in the water, stirring, then beat in the butter and cheese.
Spoon the mushrooms over the polenta.
